headline: New Windows zero-day, SignDrop, grants SYSTEM-level privileges
summary: A security researcher released a new Windows zero-day exploit, dubbed SignDrop, that lets attackers gain SYSTEM-level privileges. One outlet identifies the researcher as Abdelhamid Naceri, also known as Nightmare Eclipse, and describes them as disgruntled. Accounts differ on whether the flaw is exploitable broadly or requires local user access.
